rationale: The artwork was verified by matching the 2007 original Domino release of Favourite Worst Nightmare. MusicBrainz (MBID 0b66d93c-176c-3c2d-aede-477063d613e0) and the Cover Art Archive provide a definitive match for the original edition. Discogs (release 957352, catalog DNO 136) confirms the label and year for the original release. Two independent sources (MB/CAA and Discogs) agree on the identity of the original edition art.
